CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_club_owner(p_club_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "ClubMember"
    WHERE "clubId" = p_club_id
    AND "userId" = auth.uid()::text
    AND role = 'OWNER'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.am_i_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  is_admin boolean;
begin
  select (role = 'ADMIN') into is_admin
  from public."Profile"
  where id = auth.uid()::text;
  
  return coalesce(is_admin, false);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_conversation_timestamp()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE "Conversation"
    SET "updatedAt" = now()
    WHERE "id" = NEW."conversationId";
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_jobs(query text, lim integer DEFAULT 20, off integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS SETOF "Job"
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT * FROM "Job"
  WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (
      query = '' OR
      to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(description, ''))
        @@ plainto_tsquery('english', query)
    )
  ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
  LIMIT lim OFFSET off;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.award_job_applied_achievement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "CareerAchievement"("userId", "type", "metadata")
  VALUES (NEW."userId", 'JOB_APPLIED', jsonb_build_object('jobId', NEW."jobId"))
  ON CONFLICT ("userId", "type") DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.award_resume_uploaded_achievement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "CareerAchievement"("userId", "type", "metadata")
  VALUES (NEW."userId", 'RESUME_UPLOADED', '{}')
  ON CONFLICT ("userId", "type") DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_conversation_access(convo_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Basic check: is the user a participant and is their status ACCEPTED?
  -- We use auth.uid() directly which is safer in SECURITY DEFINER context
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."ConversationParticipant"
    WHERE "conversationId" = convo_id
    AND "userId" = (auth.uid())::text
    AND status = 'ACCEPTED'::"ConversationStatus"
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_safe_profile(target_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, "fullName" text, username text, "avatarUrl" text, bio text, department text, role text, "universityId" text, "yearOfStudy" integer, "reputationPoints" integer, "createdAt" timestamp without time zone, "updatedAt" timestamp without time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    p.id, p."fullName", p.username, p."avatarUrl", p.bio, p.department,
    p.role, p."universityId", p."yearOfStudy", p."reputationPoints",
    p."createdAt", p."updatedAt"
  FROM "Profile" p
  WHERE p.id = target_user_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_platform_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Profile" p
    WHERE p.id = (auth.uid())::text
      AND p.role = 'ADMIN'::"UserRole"
      AND p."universityId" IS NULL
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_university_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Profile" p
    WHERE p.id = (auth.uid())::text
      AND p.role = 'ADMIN'::"UserRole"
      AND p."universityId" IS NOT NULL
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_conversation_creator_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- If it's a new conversation participant and they are the creator of the conversation
  -- (or if it's a direct message and they are the sender)
  IF NEW.status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public."Conversation" 
    WHERE id = NEW."conversationId" 
    AND ("createdBy" = NEW."userId" OR "createdBy" IS NULL)
  ) THEN
    NEW.status := 'ACCEPTED';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_documents(query_embedding vector, match_threshold double precision, match_count integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, content text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  caller_university_id text;
BEGIN
  -- Derive university scope from the authenticated caller. Never accept it
  -- from a parameter — that was the FC-15 bug.
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  SELECT p."universityId" INTO caller_university_id
  FROM "Profile" p
  WHERE p.id = (auth.uid())::text;

  -- If caller has no university affiliation (FC-29 ghost user), return no rows.
  -- Previous version returned ALL documents in this case via an IS NULL escape.
  IF caller_university_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    re.id,
    re.content,
    1 - (re.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM "ResourceEmbedding" re
  LEFT JOIN "Resource" r ON re."resourceId" = r.id
  LEFT JOIN "Course" c ON r."courseId" = c.id
  WHERE 1 - (re.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
    AND c."universityId" = caller_university_id
  ORDER BY re.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_resource_upvotes(row_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_inserted boolean;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  -- Try to insert a vote row. If duplicate, do nothing (no inflation).
  INSERT INTO "ResourceVote" ("resourceId", "userId")
  VALUES (row_id, (auth.uid())::text)
  ON CONFLICT ("resourceId", "userId") DO NOTHING;

  -- Recompute upvote count from the vote table for accuracy.
  UPDATE "Resource" r
  SET upvotes = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ResourceVote" v WHERE v."resourceId" = r.id
  )
  WHERE r.id = row_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_post_view_count(p_post_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  -- Only increment if the post is visible to the caller per the new SELECT policies.
  -- (We rely on the SELECT policy from fix 04 to filter; if the caller can SELECT
  -- the post, they can bump the view count.)
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Post" WHERE id = p_post_id) THEN
    UPDATE "Post" SET "viewCount" = COALESCE("viewCount", 0) + 1 WHERE id = p_post_id;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_university_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "Profile" p
    JOIN "UniversityAdminRole" uar
      ON uar."userId" = p.id
    WHERE p.id = (auth.uid())::text
      AND p.role = 'ADMIN'::"UserRole"
      AND p."universityId" IS NOT NULL
      AND uar."universityId" = p."universityId"
      AND uar."isSuper" = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.grant_university_admin(p_target_user_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_university_id text;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
  END IF;

  IF NOT is_university_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'University admin privileges required';
  END IF;

  SELECT p."universityId"
  INTO v_actor_university_id
  FROM "Profile" p
  WHERE p.id = (auth.uid())::text;

  UPDATE "Profile"
  SET role = 'ADMIN'::"UserRole",
      "universityId" = v_actor_university_id,
      "updatedAt" = now()
  WHERE id = p_target_user_id
    AND "universityId" = v_actor_university_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target user must belong to your university';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO "UniversityAdminRole"("userId", "universityId", "isSuper")
  VALUES (p_target_user_id, v_actor_university_id, false)
  ON CONFLICT ("userId") DO UPDATE
  SET "universityId" = EXCLUDED."universityId";

  -- FC-13 fix: removed the auto-bootstrap clause that elevated the caller
  -- to super-admin if no super existed. Super-admin must now be granted
  -- explicitly via grant_university_super_admin (platform-admin only).
END;
$function$
